population: All484 paired workloads and187679 test records from saved500-file tutorial reconstruction audit. Groups partition the observed candidate counts.
metric_numeric_source: Recomputed from saved runtime maps. Private original float32 official-throughput labels were not supplied; overall agreement with uploaded official summary was within5.3e-10. These grouped figures use runtime ratios, not independently reconstructed official labels.

metric_definitions.top_1_score: Minimum candidate runtime divided by selected runtime.
metric_definitions.top_5_score: Mean over prefixes k=1..5 of minimum runtime divided by minimum runtime among first k predicted candidates.

aggregation: Within each group/model, weight every workload score by its test-record count and divide by total records in the group.
interpretation: Descriptive natural candidate-count grouping only. Workload identity/type and candidate-count group are confounded;468 workloads have400 candidates while only16 have6-88. This is not a controlled candidate-size ablation and does not establish an effect of candidate count. No additional calls or confidence intervals.
unchanged_artifacts: Original reported Random0 and Jev outputs remain unchanged.
